purpose: ROI stereo-retention probe: keep candidate_0032 thresholds and validate the code-level fix that preserves cached stereo evidence when an ROI refresh does not inherit distance for the refreshed region.
expected_effect: Keep local ROI refresh active on local_motion_roi_probe.
Reduce far_stereo_failed events after ROI refresh by preserving cached stereo-bearing regions that are not replaced by refreshed stereo evidence.
Expose ROI refreshed-region, ROI stereo-reuse, and ROI stereo-failed counts for the next tuning pass.
risk: Preserving overlapping cached stereo regions can temporarily keep stale rough-distance evidence inside the refreshed ROI.
This remains a deterministic ROI probe and should not replace candidate_0030 as slow-pan best.
